name: Pact of Blood
storyline:
A hunter moved silently through the forest, tracking the prints of a deer. It led him deep into the woods, far from villages, far from everything. Suddenly, the sky tore open – an explosion shook both the heavens and the ground. And just like that... it was over.

Dark, bloody magic flooded the world.

Everything alive screamed, burned, and died. The land collapsed into chaos. But him – he was still breathing.

The ground beneath his feet began to glow with ancient energy.

An old sacred place, long forgotten among the roots of the forest, had awakened. It wrapped him in a magical barrier – the only thing that saved him from the raging destruction. From that moment on, he was alone.

Trapped in his own salvation.

But then, between the trees, a portal appeared. Mysterious… pulsing… ALIVE…
summary: Blood is the price of survival, and you are trapped forever. Explore kingdoms through ancient portals, battle twisted creatures, and craft the tools you need to survive in this first-person single-player survival adventure.
